pizza.name: Pizza Slice
pizza.advice: Moderate calorie density. Consider pairing with a fresh garden salad to boost fiber intake.

burger.name: Cheeseburger
burger.advice: High in saturated fat and sodium. Swap fries for grilled veggies or enjoy as an occasional treat.

salad.name: Mediterranean Garden Salad
salad.advice: Nutrient-dense with high antioxidant and micronutrient density. Great low-calorie density meal.

biryani.name: Chicken Biryani
biryani.advice: Rich in lean protein and aromatic spices. Pair with cucumber raita to aid digestion and balance calories.

pasta.name: Pasta Carbonara / Alfredo
pasta.advice: High carbohydrate energy source. Whole grain pasta alternatives increase satiety and sustained glucose release.

grilled_chicken.name: Grilled Chicken Breast with Herbs
grilled_chicken.advice: Exceptional lean protein source with near-zero carbs. Perfect for muscle repair and fat loss diets.

sushi.name: Sushi / Salmon Nigiri & Rolls
sushi.advice: High in heart-healthy Omega-3 fatty acids from fish. Watch out for sodium in soy sauce dips.

dosa.name: Crispy Masala Dosa with Sambar
dosa.advice: Fermented batter promotes gut microbiome diversity. Lentil-based sambar adds vegetable protein and fiber.

fruit_bowl.name: Fresh Fruit & Berry Medley
fruit_bowl.advice: Rich in natural vitamins, polyphenols, and hydration. Ideal pre-workout snack or clean dessert.

french_fries.name: Golden French Fries
french_fries.advice: Calorie-dense with high glycemic index. Try air-fried sweet potato wedges as a lower-calorie alternative.

oatmeal.name: Oatmeal Porridge with Nuts & Berries
oatmeal.advice: Contains beta-glucan soluble fiber known to lower LDL cholesterol and sustain satiety for hours.

sandwich.name: Club Sandwich with Turkey & Veggies
sandwich.advice: Well-balanced macronutrient profile. Use whole wheat bread and mustard rather than heavy mayonnaise.
